summary: Create one directory in the vault.

input_schema.directory_path: string | The full path of the directory to create.
input_schema.recursive: boolean | optional | Create parent directories if they don't exist. Defaults to false.

output_schema.path: string | The full path of the created directory.
output_schema.name: string | The name of the created directory.
output_schema.entry_type: string | The type of the entry (will be 'directory').
output_schema.size_bytes: integer | The size of the entry in bytes (will be 0).
output_schema.created_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the directory was created.
output_schema.updated_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the directory was last updated.
output_schema.revision: string | The revision identifier for the entry.
